scope: Proposition 3.5 (Conditional unforced crossings) of the manuscript “Thermal FK–Ising interfaces and massive SLE” (preprints/Thermal-FK-Ising-interfaces-and-massive-SLE-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 223 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c2a2a4a8b4213752), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The regularly drawn medial interfaces in domains of diameter at most L satisfy condition G2 of [3], uniformly over the allowed meshes, domains, and thermal parameters.
